description: Routing: how much engineering effort one task needs. The score maps to a lane: below 1.5 haiku, below 3.0 sonnet, else opus. Advisory only.
instructions: How much engineering effort will an autonomous coding agent need to complete this change in a native SwiftUI app, including tests and docs?
criteria: Trivial: a one-line, copy or doc change
Small: a local change in one component with a simple test
Moderate: several files or a new journey test, some investigation
Large: cross-cutting change, several components or a tricky root cause
Very large: new architecture, data or service work, or many surfaces
output: Pre-read hint line: an advisory Haiku, Sonnet or Opus lane; the owner's routing and the orchestrator win.
evidence: Last 50 merged PRs: Spearman 0.74 with lines changed, 0.79 with files changed, from the PR text (a post-hoc description; an issue report may carry less signal). Advisory lane hint only; never routes by itself.
